detail.message: actor observation missing fields ['memory']; the actor input is a closed set and a missing field cannot be zero-filled

ActorObservation carries privileged fields ['stage_truth']; the actor may see pixels and its own executed keys only (forbidden: ['engine_frame', 'seed', 'script_id', 'stage_truth', 'enemy_table', 'resource_truth', 'teacher_action', 'future_tape'])
global_rgb: shape (3, 224, 320) != required (3, 240, 320); resizing or interpolation into another shape is refused, not adapted
memory: dtype uint8 != required float32; a Python list of ints infers uint8 — pass floats or a typed array for a float32 field
history_valid[1] is False after a valid entry; missing history in the middle of the window cannot be represented (a zero row would be read as executed idle)
executed_key_history: value 2 at leaf 0 outside [0, 1]; it does not fit uint8
elapsed_capture_s: leaf 0 -0.5 < minimum 0.0
effective_frames 3.0 is 1.0 frames away from the nominal 2 (tolerance 0.5); a dropped/duplicated frame or a pause must be recorded as invalid, not rounded to the normal step
duration_source=external_controller_clock must not carry elapsed_game_frames; the engine frame counter is truth the R1 actor may not read
duration_source=engine_elapsed_frames requires elapsed_game_frames; the engine reports whole frames and no other field may stand in for it
record carries 'done'; terminated / truncated / segment_end are three different facts and may not share one done field
terminated and truncated are both true; a terminal end and a sampling interruption are mutually exclusive

truncated=True requires truncation_reason in ['rollout_limit', 'frame_budget', 'time_limit', 'resource_limit', 'owner_preempt', 'delivery_timeout', 'capture_gap', 'protocol_invalid', 'other'], got None
bootstrap_mask must be 0 on a terminated episode; the terminal reward is the value target, not V(next_obs)
truncated=True with bootstrap_mask=1 requires terminal_observation_ref; bootstrapping an interrupted segment without its last genuine observation would use a reset image
bootstrap_mask=1 on a continuing step requires next_obs_ref; there is no default next observation
next_obs_ref 'obs:same' is the post-reset observation; a reset image is not the next state of this episode and cannot bootstrap it
